etymology.historical_story: Freya is associated with Freyja, a goddess in Norse tradition whose name means “lady.” The Swedish History Museum describes her connections with love, fertility, beauty and magic. This background explains the name’s cultural associations, but it does not establish whom the lowercase token in this packet denotes.
